value.rationale: The sandwich relation models a natural representation problem for an idempotent and a square-zero element. The closed rank triple count extends strictly beyond the previously covered one-sided-zero slice and produces a sharp geometric dimension floor(11 n^2/13) with a nontrivial thirteen-periodic top-component law. The result is a complete natural geometric and arithmetic invariant, not an arbitrary small computation.
